gwendolyne sabuki.name: Gwendolyne Sabuki
gwendolyne sabuki.origin: ===Known background=== Gwendolyne "Gwenny" Lou Sabuki was a Japanese-American citizen, who, like all Japanese-Americans, was rounded up during WW2 and placed inside a relocation camp. From this camp she was kidnapped, along with her father, Dr. Hijiri "Sam" Sabuki, by Agent Axis, a super-humanly powered operative for the Axis powers. As a result, she was present at a stateside battle in which sidekicks James Buchanan "Bucky" Barnes and Toro (Thomas Raymond) of the superhero team the Invaders fought against Agent Axis. Axis placed her, David "Davey" Mitchell, Bucky, and Toro into a machine designed to restore Agent Axis to his normal form. But before this could take place, Bucky and Toro tried to escape, and in the ensuing brawl, one of Sam Sabuki's machines exploded, granting super-human powers to both Gwenny Lou and David Mitchell. Gwenny Lou gained the power to generate light and energy and to project golden force beams from her hands, while Mitchell gained the ability to spin at superhuman speeds. Gwenny Lou assumed the alias of Golden Girl; David, that of "the Human Top." The four youthful heroes defeated Agent Axis, and later formed the Kid Commandos, who were allied with the adult Invaders. ===After World War II=== Gwenny Lou later helped found the post-war version of the British super-hero team the V-Battalion, and after reaching adulthood, she eventually changed her primary super-heroic alias to Golden Woman. Gwendolyne Lou Sabuki died in 1961. It is not known how she died. ===Known offspring=== Gwenny Lou's son, Kenji, became the super-hero called Golden Sun, while her granddaughters Ameiko and Ryoki became, respectively, Goldfire and Radiance. Kenji Sabuki and Ameiko Sabuki have both died since then.

In , the Green Goblin attempts to kill Mary Jane the same way he did Gwen, but Spider-Man saves her by firing multiple web-lines. In it's revealed that the whiplash of being caught by Spider-Man's webline was what killed Gwen, and that she was conscious up until the moment of her death. In , Gerry Conway speculated that Stan Lee had modeled Gwen after his wife Joan Lee, similar to Sue Storm.
fields.trivia: Several subsequent of Spider-Man's adventures have contained echoes of Gwen's death when other women have fallen great heights during Spider-Man's battles. On most occasions he has saved them by jumping after them and working with their momentum, rather than trying to stop them with his webbing. Examples of this include , , , , and ; with Peter saving Sha Shan, Joyce Delaney, Mary Jane Watson, Mary Jane again, and Anna Maria. In the final instance, Spider-Man acknowledged that he had been training thousands of times in case this situation happened again. Aunt May was originally going to die in instead of Gwen. Gwen and Harry Osborn first met and became friends on Mother's Day. Gwen Stacy was 20 years old at the time of her death.

gwyneth.name: Gwyneth
gwyneth.origin: Seeking final revenge on Daredevil, Mysterio put together an elaborate plan to destroy the hero that would take over a year to achieve. He had a young 16 year old girl, Gwyneth, abducted, drugged, and impregnated through artificial insemination. When Gwyneth found out she was pregnant, her parents were distraught. Gwyneth was an average student in school who frequently skipped out of gym class. In the months before her baby was delivered, she cried herself to sleep often. One morning she woke up to find her father dead and her mother being beheaded. Gwyneth had to deliver the baby on her own. Her baby in her arms, Gwyneth ran from some men who were after her. Just as a car nearly struck her, it was stopped by the hero Daredevil, but Gwyneth just kept running. Asleep on the streets later, Gwyneth saw a vision of angels and they told her that her child was the newborn messiah, and that she was to take her to Daredevil, whose true identity was Matt Murdock. Gwyneth pushed her way past secretary Kim at Murdock's clinic and watched as Foggy Nelson left. She explained the vision to Matt, gave him the baby, and quickly left before he could really react. Gwyneth kept running, expecting that she would just need to lay low until Murdock returned her baby, but she was captured by Mister Gabriel, an agent of Mysterio. Gwyneth was quietly killed and buried.

gwythr.name: Gwythr
gwythr.origin: ===Origins=== Gwythr was the son of Nuada, conceived during a time when Nuada temporarily inhabited a mortal host while serving as the King of Britain. As a member of the Tuatha de Danaan, Gwythr was venerated as the god of winter. His younger brother, Gwynn, was associated with springtime. ===The Eternal Conflict=== Gwythr became embroiled in a long-standing conflict with Gwynn over Creiddylad, the daughter of Leir. Although Creiddylad had been promised to Gwythr, Gwynn abducted her, sparking a relentless rivalry between the brothers. This struggle repeated itself annually, with Gwythr reclaiming Creiddylad at the onset of winter and Gwynn seizing her again with the arrival of spring.

gynosure.name: Gynosure
gynosure.origin: The Gynosure was the keeper of knowledge and guardian of the birthing chambers in the United Sisterhood Republic. When they began malfunctioning, causing defective births, Gynosure called Lyra, the empress's daughter and one of their greatest warriors, and sent her on a journey to the realm of men to seize replacement parts to repair the cradle. After the mission failed, Gynosure commanded Lyra to travel back to the past and seek out Norman Osborn, a worshipped hero in the future. Lyra was to procreate with him and give birth to a new generation of female warriors, but, in the end, her A.I. companion, Boudicca, saved the day by hiding the replacement parts in the present to be found in the future. With the Cradle fixed, Gynosure allowed Lyra to remain in the present and find her true path in life.

gyre raptor.name: Gyre (Raptor)
gyre raptor.origin: On the planet Shard, the leader of a Kree archaeology team discovered a glowing green crystal deep within its cavern. He accidentally bonded with the crystal, becoming Gyre, the Raptor. With the Raptor's personality dominant over his body, Gyre became hostile towards Nova and Darkhawk before Shard was consumed by the Fault. Gyre was later summoned in a magical construct inside the Fault by a younger version of the Sphinx to assist in battling the champions of his older self, to compete for the possession of two Ka stones. Gyre faced against Darkhawk, who ultimately won the fight by driving Gyre out of his host, freeing the archaeologist to whom he was bonded. ===Infinity Countdown=== Seeking to liberate the the real Raptors from the Tree of Shadows, the Fraternity of Raptors took Nova's brother Robbie Rider aka Talon-R to the Shi'ar Outpost IV so he could open a doorway to the Null Space with the power of his Nega-Bands. To their surprise, the real Raptors were already free and no longer needed to bond with a living being to work including Gyre. The freed Raptors killed all the pretenders save for Talon-R, who used the Nega-Bands to protect himself. Needing a living being to serve as the willing tribute of a ritual that would unlock the true power of the Starhawk within their ranks, Gyre convinced Talon-R to join them in their quest to bring order to the galaxy. With a subdued Chris Powell serving as the forced tribute, Gyre completed the ritual and transformed Talon-R into the Dark Starhawk using Chris' Raptor Amulet. Chris was able to fully bond with his armor mentally and chased after the Raptors to stop them from razing Earth. Chris was aided by Nova and Death's Head. During the fight, Dark Starhawk decided Gyre's cruelty was incompatible with the Starhawk's true purpose and destroyed him.

h g rachmanikoff.name: H.G. Rachmanikoff
h g rachmanikoff.origin: Rachmanikoff was a Hollywood director who was commissioned by producer Montgomery Jeffry to make a film starring the Young Allies acting as themselves in an adventure. During the filming, several accidents occurred and even the death of a cameraman and the lead actor Bruce Brent all caused by the Nazi saboteur the Owl, who was commissioned by Hitler to break down the morale of the Americans and the Owl attempted to do so by trying to eliminate the Young Allies. Also in the final filming of the film, the Owl also organized an attempted invasion by the Imperial Japanese forces that was foiled by the Young Allies with Captain America and the Human Torch. Recovering from the confusion following the foiled invasion attempt, Rachmanikoff who had continued with the filming, exclaimed all satisfied that the film would be colossal.

haag alien.name: Haag (Alien)
haag alien.origin: Haag was an alien sportsman who traveled across space in search of increasingly dangerous prey. Viewing humanity as a new and exotic challenge, he arrived on Earth during the modern era with the intention of conducting a large-scale hunt — with humans as his targets. While operating in Africa, Haag initiated contact with big-game hunter Bret Marlowe, becoming the first human to learn of the alien’s intentions. Confident in his technological superiority, Haag openly revealed his plan to capture humans for sport, underestimating humanity’s ability to resist. Despite Marlowe’s attempts to warn authorities, Haag began his hunt before meaningful defenses could be organized. Using advanced equipment and his spacecraft, he demonstrated overwhelming advantages over conventional human methods of tracking and capture. However, Haag’s confidence proved to be his weakness. By studying traditional elephant-hunting techniques, Marlowe devised a counterstrategy based on deception rather than force. Lured into pursuing what he believed was easy prey, Haag followed Marlowe into a prepared ambush. At the critical moment, Earth’s military deployed a massive net over Haag’s vessel, immobilizing it and leaving the alien unable to escape. Facing capture and deprived of mobility, Haag was forced to surrender, bringing his hunt to an abrupt end.

hadassah feinstein.name: Hadassah Feinstein
hadassah feinstein.origin: Hazel Fontaine was born Hadassah Feinstein, but changed her name when she became an actress due to the prevalent anti-semitic attitudes of the day. Her career took off after marrying Hollywood movie producer Irwin Oppenheim, making her a very famous movie star by the mid 1930s. One day, while nude sunbathing at the rooftop pool of the illustrious La Floridita hotel in Asuncion, Paraguay, she was surprised by the sudden appearance of Dominic Fortune who parachuted into the pool after his plane had been shot down. The starlet took an immediate liking to Fortune and invited him to dinner at the hotel that evening. Unbeknownst to her, her husband arrived at the hotel that evening as well, cutting her and Fortune's time together short. Weeks later, back in Los Angeles, she and Fortune carried on an affair, even as her husband gave Fortune a job bodyguarding three of the studio's hard-drinking movie stars. After Fortune put an end to Malcolm Upshaw's plot to overthrow the government, he returned to Los Angeles where he and Mrs. Fontaine quickly renewed their love affair. Her subsequent activities have yet to be revealed.

hades.name: Hades
hades.origin: ===Ancient Times=== Hades was the eldest son of Cronus, ruler of the superhuman extra-dimensional race of Titans, and his wife, the Titaness Rhea. However, Cronus feared Ouranos' prophecy. Any child Rhea bore him he either imprisoned in Tartarus or by his own account ate and imprisoned in his stomach to prevent them from being a threat. First he consumed Poseidon, then Hades and the rest of his siblings Hera, Demeter, and Hestia. Appalled at the mistreatment of their children, Cronus's wife Rhea concealed her sixth pregnancy from him and secretly gave birth to Zeus. When he was grown Zeus went down into Tartarus and freed Poseidon and his siblings, who had all now grown to adulthood. 250px|thumb|left ===Titanomachy=== When Zeus usurped Cronus, Pluto aided in the war by stealing Cronus' principal weapons from his palace while wearing a helmet of invisibility. Zeus became ruler of the pocket dimension called Olympus and of the race of Olympian gods, and confined the defeated Titan warriors to Tartarus, the darkest section of Hades, the Olympian underworld. He knew that they needed a stern warder and that the brooding Pluto was the only one of his siblings who found life in the underworld suitable to his temperament. Therefore, Zeus assigned ruler-ship of the entire underworld to his elder brother. Pluto was quite pleased with this new role and rarely left the underworld over the following centuries. The most infamous exception was when Pluto carried off Kore, the goddess of spring, to the underworld, to force her to become his wife. Kore's mother, the fertility goddess Demeter, was outraged, and refused to allow crops to grow in ancient Greece until Kore was returned. Eventually, a compromise was reached, and Kore spent only a portion of the year in Hades with her husband. As queen of Hades, Kore was known as Persephone. Since the time of his appointment as ruler of Hades, Pluto populated his realm with the "shades" of mortals who had worshiped the Olympian gods. When the worship of Olympian gods died out, giving way to Christianity, Zeus forbade Pluto from collecting any more "souls." Pluto obeyed the edict resentfully, having become accustomed to an ever-growing number of subjects in his realm. The bitter Pluto finally convinced himself that Zeus had proved himself to be an incompetent leader by allowing the worship of the Olympians to come to an end. Zeus, noting Pluto's increasingly ominous rebelliousness, warned him against attempting to overthrow him and sentenced him to remain monarch of Hades until Pluto could find a willing replacement. As ruler of Hades, he was also part of the Lords of the Splinter Realms. ===6th century=== In the 6th century he empowered Tyrannus and sent him to destroy Merlin. He travelled to Britannia to conquer the kingdom of Camelot and take the throne from King Arthur.He was stopped by merlin's champion the Black Knight; Sir Percy of Scandia. He was no match against the young knight and fled leaving his master Pluto to continue the battle, who ultimately lost and retreated back to his realm. ===Modern Era=== In recent years, during one of Hercules' sojourns on Earth, Pluto appeared on Earth in the guise of Hayden P. Hellman (nicknamed "Mr. Pluto"), a movie producer at California Stardust Studios. Thus disguised, Pluto had the naive Hercules sign a contract that Hercules believed was for appearing in a project film. But in fact, it was an Olympian contract binding Hercules to become Pluto's successor as ruler of Hades. Having signed the contract, Hercules was unable to battle Pluto on his own behalf, but the Asgardian god Thor fought against Pluto's forces to free Hercules. Shocked by the massive destruction wrought in Hades by Thor, Pluto realized that he loved his kingdom and could not bear to forsake it. Pluto therefore released Hercules from the contract. ===Travelling to the Future=== But Pluto still wished to add new conquests to his kingdom. He traveled to an alternate future of Earth in which nuclear radiation had transformed many human beings into inhuman-looking Mutates. Pluto brought an army of mutates back to his own time to conquer Earth for him. Pluto and his mutates were opposed by Thor, his fellow Asgardians Balder and Sif, and the United States Armed Forces. Finally, Zeus himself intervened, banishing both Pluto and his mutates to Hades. ===Death of Odin=== Later, Odin, monarch of the Asgardians, physically died. But time had been magically suspended about him so that his spirit would not yet leave his body. Pluto attempted to claim Odin's soul but was opposed by Odin's son Thor and by the Asgardian death goddess Hela. Rather than allow Pluto to deprive her of Odin's soul, Hela restored Odin to life. Odin interrupted the battle between Thor and Pluto, and Pluto returned to Hades. Still later, Pluto and his nephew Ares conspired to provoke a battle between Thor and Hercules. But Thor and Hercules learned of the deception, and Thor managed to defeat Pluto on Ear

When he was grown Zeus went down into Tartarus and freed Poseidon and his siblings, who had all now grown to adulthood. 250px|thumb|left ===Titanomachy=== When Zeus usurped Cronus, Pluto aided in the war by stealing Cronus' principal weapons from his palace while wearing a helmet of invisibility. Zeus became ruler of the pocket dimension called Olympus and of the race of Olympian gods, and confined the defeated Titan warriors to Tartarus, the darkest section of Hades, the Olympian underworld. He knew that they needed a stern warder and that the brooding Pluto was the only one of his siblings who found life in the underworld suitable to his temperament. Therefore, Zeus assigned ruler-ship of the entire underworld to his elder brother. Pluto was quite pleased with this new role and rarely left the underworld over the following centuries. The most infamous exception was when Pluto carried off Kore, the goddess of spring, to the underworld, to force her to become his wife. Kore's mother, the fertility goddess Demeter, was outraged, and refused to allow crops to grow in ancient Greece until Kore was returned. Eventually, a compromise was reached, and Kore spent only a portion of the year in Hades with her husband. As queen of Hades, Kore was known as Persephone. Pluto obeyed the edict resentfully, having become accustomed to an ever-growing number of subjects in his realm. The bitter Pluto finally convinced himself that Zeus had proved himself to be an incompetent leader by allowing the worship of the Olympians to come to an end. Zeus, noting Pluto's increasingly ominous rebelliousness, warned him against attempting to overthrow him and sentenced him to remain monarch of Hades until Pluto could find a willing replacement. Pluto attempted to claim Odin's soul but was opposed by Odin's son Thor and by the Asgardian death goddess Hela. Rather than allow Pluto to deprive her of Odin's soul, Hela restored Odin to life. Odin interrupted the battle between Thor and Pluto, and Pluto returned to Hades. Still later, Pluto and his nephew Ares conspired to provoke a battle between Thor and Hercules. fields.trivia: In Greek Mythology, Pluto (Hades) was a grim god, but not a maligned one, having nothing in common with the Christian devil, but yet, because of his connection to the dead, he has been depicted as a sinister and diabolical character in the Marvel Universe as well as in Disney's “Hercules.” In mythology, he has such an affinity to the underworld that it would be incomprehensible to him to allow anyone else to rule it. He has been portrayed more accurately in the DC Universe and “The Legendary Journeys” cosmology. While prevalent in the history of the “Legendary Journeys” timeline, Hades has barely shown any known activity in the DC Universe as he does in the Marvel Universe. The name/title Pluto, from the Greek Πλούτων (Ploutōn), emphasizes the god's, and the underworld's, status as the source of wealth and prosperity, mineral, agricultural and potentially even spiritual.; It should be noted that that the position of “god of dead” is often not equal to “god of death” or “god of the underworld.” While some cultures do unite the roles, they are not always preclusive. In Greek-Roman myth, Hades is the god of the dead while his vizier, Thanatos, the god of death, is the actual presence who guides the dead to the underworld. In Celtic Myth, Mider rules the divinities of the underworld while his son Arawn is the god of dead. In African myth, Ndriananadhary rules the underworld while Damballah rules the dead and Sagbata represents the forces of death. In Mexican myth, there are twelve lords of the underworld and one god, Ahpuch, who rules over the dead. Even in Egyptian myth, Osiris and Seth are, respectively, god of the dead and god of death. In Norse myth, Odin serves the role as god of the honored dead, while Hela rules over the spirits of those not admitted into Odin's Valhalla, a Hall of Heroes.

hadith.name: Hadith
hadith.origin: Hadith, Omen-Maker, Path-Lighter, was a God to the Queega of the Quolan System. He was said to stood for the highest aspirations and the noblest values of his world. On his hatchday, the Queega fasted. At some point, they were invaded by the Skrulls, and Hadith was apparently killed, his head exposed as a trophy in the Skrull temple, and presumably enslaved by the Skrull Pantheon. His alleged death was recorded into the Fractal Scriptures of Jemiah the Analyzer, in the verse 1.23 x 10 .

The sole appearance of the King of Zamora on panel, in "The Palace of Pleasure" ( ; October, 1982), was unnamed. Though he doesn't displayed Mitradites' drunkenness mentioned in other mentions, given Mitradites III seems to have been the king throughout the Age of Conan, it can be assumed that the King of Zamora featured in this issue was Mitradites. hadrian harmon.name: Hadrian Harmon
hadrian harmon.origin: The Angel receives a letter from a lawyer informing him that he is one of the last surviving distant family members of the Harmon estate and that he is to come to Blackmoor, England. Arriving at Harmon Manor, he meets his other distant relatives Colonel Webber Woodson and his daughter Myrna, who are waiting for another family member that lives in Australia (Charles Harmon). Inside, Woodson tells the Angel that the property is apparently haunted ever since Duke Harmon died, and that there are jewels hidden somewhere in the house. Woodson leaves the Angel and Myrna alone to inspect the cellar. Down there, Woodson finds a coffin that suddenly springs open and he is accosted by what appears to be the ghost of Duke Harmon. Woodson's weak heart causes him to pass out. Later, Myrna begins to worry about her father, and they find him in the basement as he recovers. He tells them about his encounter with the "ghost" and the Angel checks the coffin and finds it empty. They then take Woodson to bed and they all retire for the night. In his room, the Angel is confronted by the ghost of Duke Harmon. Proving that the ghost is real, the Angel is told that he died a coward dying from a gunshot while fleeing from an enemy. He tells the Angel that once one of his descendant commits an act of bravery, he will finally be able to rest. The next morning, the Angel saves Myrna and Colonel Woodson from a falling chandelier. Then the organ starts playing, and the Angel finds that there is a second set of keys in a hidden room behind the organ. He is knocked out by a mystery assailant. He wakes up in a crypt, and the ghost reappears, telling the Angel that someone is impersonating him and helps the Angel find the secret passage out of the room. Examining the organ closer, they find an extra key and press it, revealing the hidden jewels from a hidden compartment in the organ. They are confronted by the fake ghost who reveals himself to be the missing relative from Australia who is trying to kill them all so that he can take all the jewels from himself. Suddenly another chandelier breaks loose and kills the man when it falls on him ending his threat. Because of the Angel's bravery, the real ghost tells him that he can now finally rest. The Angel then tells Myrna and the Colonel that they can keep his share of the fortune, as he does not need the money.

haemon.name: Haemon
haemon.origin: Haemon was a member of the High Council of the Lizard People. After the defeat of the human soldiers sent to explore the land near their hidden town, Haemon saw Ms. Marvel fighting Khadar. Understanding how much more dangerous she was, Haemon stunned Ms. Marvel with his telepathic blasting gaze. Later, he was present during the trial of Ms. Marvel. When a fight broke out between the heroine and the guards, the monument above the trial arena was shattered and fell on Haemon's wife and child. Ms. Marvel held up the structure until they were safe. Despite being grateful to the human, Haemon tried to kill her. He blasted her with his gaze and the enormous statue fell on Ms. Marvel. But Ms. Marvel survived, defeated the Guardian, and convinced Aracht'yr to let the humans go. Haemon's hypnotic power was used to erase the captive humans' memories of the People, but one of them was actually a Dire Wraith so the hypnotic treatment didn't work on him. The Dire Wraiths thus learnt of the People's existence, and later attacked and killed almost all them, including Haemon.

hag of the pits.name: Hag of the Pits
hag of the pits.origin: left|200px|thumb|The Hag of the Pits The Hag of the Pits is a powerful sorceress residing in the Pits of Dinosaur World. haider ibn al haytham.name: Haider Ibn al-Haytham
haider ibn al haytham.origin: In the visions of Nostradamus, he sees the three members of the Last Caliphate resting in the capsules. In the mountains in Iraq, Nikola Tesla finds the three capsules where the three members of the Last Caliphate rest; he tells Mina, calling them those who mark the way and who are slowly waking up from a sleep of centuries. Hasan Ibn al-Haytham and his brothers Hamza Ibn al-Haytham and Haider Ibn al-Haytham are awakened by Nikola Tesla, Howard Stark and Nathaniel Richards. Everyone went to the Immortal City and announced to Michelangelo that they will travel to the end of human history not knowing whether to save the world or see it burn. Nikola Tesla tells his son Leonid that the three represent the branches of time, what is, what has been before and what will be., Then embarking all on the Human Machine they went into the future facing three scenarios where they would always clash with Isaac Newton. In all three scenarios, the three brothers perished in the fight with Newton and the Star Child. Leonid using the Human Machine with his powers defeated Newton, restored reality, and brought the three brothers of the Last Caliphate back to life.

hailey cooper.name: Hailey Cooper
hailey cooper.origin: thumb|right|During the events of Miles Morales Hailey Cooper was a street artist and a social activist living in Harlem. She first met Miles Morales when he happened upon her helping "HarlemStreetArtist" paint a mural featuring Spider-Man (Peter Parker). They briefly met up again during one of his mother's campaign for city council rally. Later, she found one of Kingpin's base and contacted Spider-Man (Miles Morales) through the Friendly Neighborhood App. Kingpin sent his goons after Hailey afterwards, but Spider-Man was able to rescue her. In gratitude, she gifted him her scarf and earmuffs. She was present for the Tinkerer's death, where she learned that Miles was Spider-Man. Hailey next appears as a student of Brooklyn Visions Academy and has become close friends with both Miles and Ganke Lee.

hairball 2.origin: Searching for his place in the world, Throg was sent by Thor to the Himalayas to search for a Yeti. Throg made contact with the yeti, but the pair were pulled into the Dream Realm shortly after. In the Dream Realm they encountered monstrous beasts threatening the land. Upon meeting the Pet Avengers, Ms. Lion asked what the Yeti's name was. He responded that it was too difficult for him to pronounce, so Ms. Lion decided to call him Hairball 2. With help from the other Pet Avengers and the unicorn Damiella, they were able to save the Dream Realm. After the battle, Hairball 2 decide to stay in the Dream Realm with his true love, Damiella.

hak ur.name: Hak-Ur
hak ur.origin: Hak-Ur was a captain in the army of the city of Torranna, in Grondar. As the city was monarchless, Captain Hak-Ur took his orders from the wizard Korr-Lo-Zann. He was ordered by Korr-Lo-Zann to slay any outsider that would intrude into a specific room of Torranna, where Korr-Lo-Zann and his fellow sorcerers practiced their dark arts. When Kull, exiled king of Valusia who was offered the throne of Torranna if he could find back the city's crown, found a secret passage and ended up in the room with his friends Laralei and Ridondo, he was attacked by Hak-Ur and his men. Kull took great care not to kill any of them, wanting to test them as well as preserve them for the task of retaking Valusia. The fight was eventually put to an end by the interruption of Kor-Lo-Zann. Learning that Kull was to become king, Hak-Ur pledge allegiance to him. When Larelei fled the city, Hak-Ur followed her, as she was Kull's woman. Honoring his pledge, he pursued her outside the gates of Torranna, and was thus killed by the curse laid by Syndra.

hal warpies.name: Hal (Warpies)
hal warpies.origin: The Warpie known as Hal gained his powers when he was affected by a reality warp created by Mad Jim Jaspers when he attempted to take over Great Britain. Somehow, Peeping Tom was not discovered by the agents of the R.C.X. and needed to be "rescued" from his family. However, Hal probably unconsciously heard the call of Siren and sought her out only to be discovered by Uncle Lex and became a member of the "Parasites". thumb|left|260px All of the Parasites were trained by Uncle Lex to use their powers to become petty thieves and to obey him blindly, which the children did without question. Since Uncle Lex didn't value the children under his care, he taught them to not really care about each other as well. Later, when a jewelry heist went bad, Snap became scared and teleported blindly and was struck by a city bus, killing him. Snap's death upset the Cherubim, especially Fern, who were all still mourning the recent death of Cherub Whirlwind. When they returned to the Den, Fern confronted Uncle Lex and the Cherubim decided to leave them and find a new home. However, Uncle Lex had other ideas and wouldn't let them and set the Parasites against the Cherubim. Hal fought and defeated the twins AC-DC, by using his powerful breath to force them away from him. Like all of the Warpies he was depowered by Captain Britain on Otherworld using the Sword of Might.

hal goldman.name: Hal Goldman
hal goldman.origin: Officer Goldman told Mary Jane Watson-Parker that Jonathan Caesar was suspected for the incident against director Hal McGee. Some days later, when Jonathan Caesar was threatening MJ at the 'Secret Hospital' set, Officer Goldman arrived and killed Caesar. He then told MJ he was only an NYPD file clerk, but was her biggest fan. He admitted being behind the attacks on the abusive 'Secret Hospital' fan, Hal McGee, and even her husband Peter Parker. When MJ rejected him, he pointed his gun at her, but MJ was able to spray Goldman in the face with hairspray and clobber him with her purse.

hal jordens.name: Hal Jordens
hal jordens.origin: Hal Jordens was a commercial pilot and had aspirations to own his own airport to test experimental aircraft. When World War II broke out, Hal was drafted into the air force and fought in the South Pacific. One day, he cracked up his plane, leading to the death of a fellow soldier. The guilt Hal felt developed into a fear of flying. Relieved of duty, Hal intended to marry his girl Maria, and soon learned that a member of his family had passed away and willed him a portion of a plantation in Cuba and a large sum of money. On his way there, he was warned that to go to Cuba would be his death. hala.name: Hala
hala.origin: Hala is one of the last of the Kree and the lone surviving member of the Accuser Corps following the fall of the Kree Empire as a result of the destruction of the Kree Homeworld. ===Secret Wars=== After the Multiverse was destroyed by incursions and recreated in the form of Battleworld, Hala appeared on Knowhere shortly after the Guardians of Knowhere had defeated Yotat the Destroyer. Gamora and Aldrif Doomsdottir of the Thors tried talking with Hala, but as she spoke only Kree, neither one could understand her. Gamora advised Aldrif to act peacefully, but the Thor didn't listen, so Hala attacked the pair and defeated them quite easily. The Nova Corps came in to subdue her, but Hala defeated them as well, killing many of them in the process. When Hala saw the Kree symbol on Captain Marvel's uniform, she paused for a moment, allowing Aldrif and Gamora to recover and seize the opportunity to attack by striking her in the back with their swords, which seemingly killed her. After that, Gamora and Aldrif conversed about Gamora staying on Knowhere and obeying God Emperor Doom's laws. Suddenly Hala sprang back to life and impaled Aldrif with her weapon, killing the Thor. Gamora angrily attacked the woman but was almost killed herself. Fortunately, Drax the Destroyer and Rocket Raccoon came to help, and together the Guardians finally defeated her. thumb|left ===All-New, All-Different Marvel=== After Reed Richards restored the Multiverse, Hala tracked Gamora to Spartax. There she engaged the Guardians of the Galaxy in a brief skirmish. After being knocked unconscious by The Thing, Drax the Destroyer unintentionally engaged fail-safes built into Hala's Universal Weapon, allowing the Accuser to regain the upper hand. Hala then placed Emperor Peter Quill in a escape pod, so that he could watch from afar as she destroyed Spartax, before heading to his other homeworld, Earth, as punishment for his alleged involvement in the genocide of her people. Hala continued wreaking havoc through Spartax, defeating the Royal Guard before shifting her attention to the defeat Guardians; however, they had been able to escape and regroup. The Guardians distracted Hala long enough to reach their ship and recover Quill. Gamora sacrificed herself and confronted Hala in order to buy the Guardians time to retreat. As soon as she discovered Peter Quill was not in her grasp, Hala continued storming Spartax while beating up Gamora, who was already in a bad shape, demanding to know the location of the Spartax Empire emperor. The Guardians returned to aid Gamora and tried to talk Hala out of destroying the planet, but she refused. Kitty Pryde snuck up on her and partially phased her through the ground, pinning her down, allowing The Thing to jump from the ship at a great altitude and crash into Hala with incredible force, knocking her down for good. Venom then proceeded to seize her staff and destroy it. During the subsequent havoc wreaked by the arrival of Yotat the Destroyed, Hala fled from the battlefield. She was found crawling in the subway system of Spartax, and eventually arrested, though the Spartax Council ultimately decided to send her back to whatever remained of the Kree Empire.

hala child nine.name: Hala Child Nine
hala child nine.origin: The Kree identified by a Mim Unit as Hala Child Nine and nicknamed "Bean" by Captain Marvel in honor of her home town, Boston, was one of numerous refugees who sought aid on Earth following the destruction of Hala. ===Alien Nation=== The Mim Unit attempted to kidnap her from the Eastern Europe Alpha Flight Displaced Alien Refugee Camp in the Black Forest of Germany in order to exploit her unique HLA Marker, but was thwarted by Captain Marvel. Mim eventually acquired Bean, despite Alpha Flight's best efforts to protect her, and Dr. Eve then conducted a Helix experiment to distill the twelve HLA Markers into a single composite, HLA-12, which she had discovered could trigger Captain Marvel's hybrid physiology to enter into a mindless rage, making her the perfect test subject to help improve the Mim Units. TAI convinced Carol that she needed to remove Bean from the Helix to interrupt the experiment, but in doing so it converted Hala Child Nine from a corporeal being into one of pure Hala energy. ===Dark Origins=== After learning that the disruption to the Helix had transformed Bean into the Multiform, a repository of Hala's power throughout all time and dimension, Dr. Eve tracked her to the ruins of Hala, where she had been called by the Supreme Intelligence, or rather, the Plex Intelligence that stood in its place. Dr. Eve believed the appearance of the Multiform, as well as the resurrection of the Intelligence were signs of the return of the Kree, and she convinced the Hala Child to help her fulfill her mission to rebuild the Kree Empire. To this end, Dr. Eve and her Mim Unit tracked the Reality Stone across many dimensions. They eventually found it in a completely separate universe, which they reached by making use of a cosmic singularity that pulled them into it, with Bean's cryptic warning having lured Captain Marvel into following them in the process. Dr. Eve later kidnapped Carol, who was now in possession of the Reality Stone, and took her to this universe's Hala, where she planned to have Bean possess Danvers' body and make her use the Reality Stone to bring this reality's intact Hala to replace the destroyed Hala from the Prime Marvel Universe. Seeing the fear of Hala's Kree children, Carol managed to make Bean see reason, and they stopped the process, instead using the Reality Stone to return to the Alpha Flight Low-Orbit Space Station in their original universe. ===Finding Home=== Bean felt a call from other Hala children in a part of the universe and followed it, finding a research facility on Ipulus funded by a rogue Kree faction known as the Hala Four. She was welcomed into the facility where she befriended the children who looked exactly like her but upon coming into contact with them they all inadvertently spliced into more copies of herself who all shared one mind. These duplicates came to be known as the Hala Children, and upon running some tests on them and Bean the doctors came to the conclusion that the true purpose of the Multiform was to rebirth Hala's population. However, the Hala Four wanted to make a weapon out them, but saw the girls as a threatening virus that needed to be exterminated, and when they were discovered by the Kree/Skrull Alliance's emperor they attempted to destroy all evidence. One of the doctors named Istra contacted the Starjammers to smuggle Bean out of Ipulus in order to keep her safe. Unfortunately, the Hala Four followed them, forcing the crew to go to K'rsak space where they were all immediately arrested for parking tickets. They were forced to pay their sentencing by working as miners in the Ashmount Prison, but luckily before they could be incarcerated the Starjammers sent a distress signal to Captain Marvel. Carol had herself imprisoned and reunited with Bean and the Starjammers, at which point she planned to break everyone out. Captain Marvel disabled the security system and fought the guards to buy the Starjammers time to escape. Bean was reluctant to leave Carol behind, but upon arriving at the ship bay the Starjammers noticed the Hala Four waiting for them. Not wanting to endanger her companions, Bean took one of the shuttles and flew near the Four's ships to presumably reason with them. The Hala Four refused to hear her and fired at her shuttle, and thinking they successfully killed her proceeded to leave. Carol was able to reach her just in time to save and bring her to the Starjammer. With no one after her anymore, Bean was brought back to Ipulus where she was reunited with the Hala Children. After passing some time with Captain Marvel and the Starjammers, Bean and the Children bid the heroes farewell and continued to live peacefully together for the foreseeable future.

hale carrick.name: Hale Carrick
hale carrick.origin: Leader of the Under-Yorkers, and father of Leilani. He wanted to force his daughter to hand over his grandchildren so that he could raise Jasper to take over as heir to his empire, but he was opposed by Spider-Man who managed to prevent his daughter and grandchildren from being handed over. Carrick later attempted to have Spider-Man killed as a result, which subsequently led to the overthrow of Under York's regime by Spider-Man and the Fantastic Four.

haley blanding.name: Haley Blanding
haley blanding.origin: Haley Blanding is the adoptive sister to Alex Summers. Haley's parents were Andrew and Mrs. Blanding, whose son Todd had been killed in a car accident. Alex was pressured to act as a replacement Todd, which he tried to do as best as he could. Alex and Haley became friends. When Todd's killer Vincent kidnapped Alex and Haley, Alex manifested his mutant powers for the first time, incinerating Vincent. Mister Sinister appeared, quite surprised to find that Alex’s potential possibly exceeded his brother Scott's. Unfortunately, Alex lacked any control over his powers. Sinister placed psi-blocks on both Alex and Haley, causing them to forget everything that happened that night.

halphas.name: Halphas
halphas.origin: As part of preparations for the "war between the forces of good and the forces of evil," Mephisto put several plans into action, one including removing Nightcrawler and his magic-inclined adopted family from his path. His distant cousin ("several times removed") Halphas was tasked with this mission in addition to retrieving the Soulsword. Shortly after Nightcrawler revealed his teleporting powers to his adopted brother Stephan Szardos, Stephan admitted to a fear that the magic running through their family would lead to him hurting people. The changes that lead Stephan to jealousy and the eventual killing of Mutant children turned out to be from Hive's influence, suggesting that Nightcrawler was not responsible for Stephan's death at all. While in pursuit of the Soulsword, Hive possessed Nightmare and ambushed Magik (Jimaine Szardos) in Limbo. He subdued the guardian snakes, then captured and tortured Jimaine. However, Margali Szardos managed to defeat him, rescuing her daughter. Nightmare had no recollection of his time while possessed by Hive. Hive then possessed Amos Jardine as part of a mission to kill Nightcrawler. The demon launched an assault on the circus consisting of Man-Thing, Gator, Carrion, and a horde of zombies. After leaving Jardine, Hive found a new host in Wolverine. He stabbed Christine Palmer and drew Nightcrawler into a battle. After Nightcrawler captured the demon, Hive confessed to merely being a pawn of Mephisto and died shortly after.

hamand.name: Hamand
hamand.origin: A medieval warlord, Hamand had conquered the kingdom of Cybernia, but was not accepted by its people despite his army's presence. Thus, he desecrated the forbidden necropolis of Dragonhenge for one of the crowns of the past kings of Cybernia interred within. The spirit of his victim, however, immediately sought vengeance, slaying Hamand's vizier and taking his place. Unaware of this, Hamand took the wizard's advice, believing that nightmares he'd started having of attacks by unearthly creatures were premonitions, and so had a grand tower built that was mystically rendered impenetrable. Once it was finished, Hamand locked himself inside, only for his advisor to then reveal himself as the reanimated king whose crown he'd stolen. It was then Hamand realized he'd been trapped, as the spells that prevented the tower from being entered also meant it could not be left, making it so that they would not be interrupted as the dead king took vengeance for his tomb being robbed for all eternity. Hamand's followers thereafter abandoned control of Cybernia, as they no longer had him to lead them... as well as being frightened away by unending screams of terror from within Hamand's tower.

hamilton slade akkaba.name: Hamilton Slade (Akkaba)
hamilton slade akkaba.origin: In the Victorian era, Hamilton Slade was born into a wealthy and prestigious family. His prestige was as a result of both his wealth and his lineage. Hamilton was a descendant of Apocalypse and had inherited a strong dose of his blood and as such was born to be the next leader of his clan. He grew up a snide and aloof child and eventually became a powerful man. Hamilton thought himself Apocalypse's equal and held no reverence for his lord except being thankful for not being born human. As leader of the clan all the members had to obey his orders whether they agreed with him or not. Most notably Jack Starsmore, a police officer at the time, was his main underling. file|left|thumb|150px|Hamilton murders his mother Soon clan members started dying mysteriously and Slade tasked Jack to cover the tracks of the clan so they could avoid being exposed. One night Jack and two police officers arrived at his house asking about Clan Akkaba. Hamilton, still very much aloof, revealed all the clan's secrets to them before murdering them. He then set off to find the one responsible for the death of his kin since he could not trust anyone else with such important work. That was the last time Hamilton was seen alive. He met his untimely demise at the hands of Dracula, and became one of the undead in 1897. Upon his return as a vampire, he and Dracula, along with the rest of Dracula's coven, waged an all out assault on Clan Akkaba. He even killed his own mother as a result, but was eventually killed by his own brother teleporting his head from the rest of his body.

hammerhead.name: Hammerhead
hammerhead.species: Human with a surgically replaced adamantium skull. Later had upper body enhanced with cybernetics
hammerhead.origin: ===Early Life=== Joseph was born in the Soviet Union and immigrated with his family to Italy as a child, aided by a mysterious figure known as the General. His father operated a garage in Toirano and insisted that the boy speak only Russian, punishing him brutally with hammer blows when he spoke Italian. Joseph lied to classmates by claiming Italian heritage, but was humiliated by a bully named Rico, who exposed him and stole his hat to reveal the scars on his skull. Joseph later murdered Rico and his girlfriend in a theater showing The Godfather Part II, catching the attention of the Maggia. Proving himself capable of murder, Joseph joined the Maggia and convinced them he was Italian so he could be fully “made.” His final initiation required him to kill his father in the family garage, which he did with a larger hammer, denouncing him in Russian before the act. Though violent and ambitious, Joseph cared for his younger sister, Antonia, who later suffered from cancer. ===Becoming Hammerhead=== Moving to New York City, Joseph rose as a Maggia hitman until he was savagely beaten and left for dead in an alley in the Bowery. There he was discovered by disgraced surgeon Dr. Jonas Harrow, who operated on him for three days, reinforcing his shattered skull with a steel alloy. When he awoke, Joseph fixated on a poster for The Al Capone Mob he had seen in the alley before losing consciousness. He reinvented himself as "Hammerhead," dressing and acting like a 1920s mobster a modern day Al Capone, compulsively speaking in old gangster slang and claiming he no longer remembered his birth name. His reinforced skull also made him resistant to telepathic and sonic attacks. ===Gang Wars with Doctor Octopus=== Hammerhead quickly built his own gang in imitation of Capone, but after the recent defeat of The Kingpin New York's underworld was up for grabs, and Hammerhead wanted it, but so did Doc Ock, sparking a gang war with Doctor Octopus. Their conflict drew in Spider-Man, who was severely injured while caught between their forces. Hammerhead fled overseas, but returned to clash with Octavius on a Canadian island housing a breeder reactor. An explosion blasted Hammerhead out of phase with reality. He returned as a ghost-like being haunting Octavius, who inadvertently restored him to corporeal form using a particle accelerator. Hammerhead attempted to force Aunt May into marrying Octavius to gain her inheritance and reactor access, but Spider-Man intervened. He later kidnapped May again during his feud with Octavius, but Spider-Man rescued her and the villains' battle ended with Hammerhead's helicopter destroyed. ===Maggia Activities=== After regaining corporeal form, Hammerhead rebuilt his Maggia crew and appeared in several scattered confrontations across New York. He clashed with Spider-Man in multiple schemes to expand his territory, including an attempted recruitment of Cloak and Dagger, which failed when the duo turned on him. He also meddled in the Hulk's rampage during Spider-Man's team-up with the Human Torch. He continued to feud with Spider-Man in further Marvel Team-Up stories. Hammerhead reclaimed a Maggia seat, running minor rackets and fighting Spider-Man several times. He donned a strength-enhancing exoskeleton in one clash with the Human Torch. He also partnered intermittently with Silvermane in Maggia dealings before the latter's cyborg resurrection. Hammerhead jockeyed for power among dons and manipulated other super-villains into proxy gang wars. ===Gang War=== Hammerhead attempted to unite all Maggia families under his leadership during a major gang war in New York. His ambitions were checked by Spider-Man's interference and by the Kingpin, who eventually reasserted his control. Hammerhead next allied himself with the Chameleon, serving as his partner in a splinter Maggia faction during the Lobo Brothers' gang war. To bolster his muscle, Hammerhead recruited Tombstone as a bodyguard. He hired the Hobgoblin to assassinate Joe Robertson, but the attempt was thwarted by Spider-Man. Tombstone, enraged at Hammerhead's manipulation, later kidnapped and beat him after gaining superhuman strength from the Diox-3 formula, leaving Hammerhead badly shaken. Hammerhead attended a Las Vegas crime conference dividing Fisk's abandoned assets, where he rubbed shoulders with dons targeted by the Punisher. === Made Men and the Sinister Twelve === During another reshuffling of power, Hammerhead clashed with rival dons including Don Fortunato and Silvermane while asserting his Maggia influence. He was later recruited by Norman Osborn into the Sinister Twelve, fighting Spider-Man alongside other villains at the Queensboro Bridge. Hammerhead resurfaced during Osborn's manipulations of the underworld, briefly asserting himself in Maggia dealings only to be undermined once more by stronger rivals. He was later recruited by Norman Osborn into the Sinister Twelve, fighting Spider-Man alongside other villains at the Queensboro Bridge. Hammerhead resurfaced during Osborn's manipulations of the underworld, briefly asserting himself in Maggia dealings only to be undermined once more by stronger rivals. hamza ibn al haytham.name: Hamza Ibn al-Haytham
hamza ibn al haytham.origin: In the visions of Nostradamus he sees the three members of the Last Caliphate resting in the capsules. In the mountains in Iraq Nikola Tesla finds the three capsules where the three members of the Last Caliphate rest; he tells Mina, calling them those who mark the way and who are slowly waking up from a sleep of centuries. Hasan Ibn al-Haytham and his brothers Hamza Ibn al-Haytham and Haider Ibn al-Haytham are awakened by Nikola Tesla, Howard Stark and Nathaniel Richards. Everyone went to the Immortal City and announced to Michelangelo that they will travel to the end of human history not knowing whether to save the world or see it burn. Nikola Tesla tells his son Leonid that the three represent the branches of time, what is, what has been before and what will be., Then embarking all on the Human Machine they went into the future facing three scenarios where they would always clash with Isaac Newton. In all three scenarios, the three brothers perished in the fight with Newton and the Star Child. Leonid using the Human Machine with his powers defeated Newton, restored reality, and brought the three brothers of the Last Caliphate back to life.

hana yanowa.name: Hana Yanowa
hana yanowa.origin: Hana Yanowa was born into the Shosei Order, a lineage of miko (巫女) Shinto shrine maidens based out of Kyoto (the spiritual center of Japan) who had protected Japan from demonic incursions from Yomi for over 800 years. In the 1800s, Hana and her twin sister Mana were destined to clash over leadership of the Shosei Order and matured into bitter rivals. But when Mana emerged victorious to become the Order's High Priestess, Hana turned her back on the Order and began to study dark and forbidden mystic arts, leading to her body being possessed by the Shinma demon Ryuki. In 1864, Mana confronted her possessed sister and trapped the souls of Ryuki, Hana, and herself within the jewel of her necklace, the Mark of Mana. thumb|left|200px|Hana being possessed by Ryuki (Earth-616)|Ryuki Decades later, in modern times, the Mark of Mana fell into the possession of Wolverine, who used it to return Mana's soul to her physical body; however, doing so also inadvertently released the souls of Hana and Ryuki. Freed from their prison, Hana and Ryuki reanimated the Shinsengumi (新選組), a force of 11 deadly samurai warriors who were executed as traitors upon the fall of the Tokugawa shogunate, so that they could be used to kill enough innocent victims to open a gateway from Ashurado and the Earth realm. Although Wolverine defeated the undead Shinsengumi, Hana and Ryuki still opened a gateway from Ashurado to Earth. Wolverine and Mana defeated the demons, and then Wolverine used his gold-coated claws to defeat Ryuki (exploiting the demon's weakness to gold, which had previously been revealed to Mana by the Amatsu-Kami Inari), while Mana killed Hana with her dagger.

hangnam hannah.name: Hangnam Hannah
hangnam hannah.origin: Hangnam Hannah was a Korean-born woman who joined the People's Liberation Army of China during the Korean War. In December 1950 she and her troops built a massive artillery cannon propped on skis to allow them to easily attack American vessels in Korean waters and then move it to a new location before battleships could fire on it. Her plot was uncovered by American Navy officials Battleship Burk and Salty Smith, who Hannah captured. However, the two Americans managed to escape and later stole the massive cannon out from under Hannah and sent it crashing into the ocean. Her subsequent activities are unknown.

hank johnson.name: Hank Johnson
hank johnson.first_appearance: Hank Johnson, Agent of Hydra Vol 1 1
hank johnson.origin: thumb|200px|left Hank Johnson was a member of Hydra. Hank married the Red Skull's personal assistant, Becky, and the two had three children, Freddie, Madeline, and an unnamed child. One night at Hydra Tower, Hank was knocked out by Nick Fury. Awakening, he discovered the corpse of his friend Gerry. At Gerry's funeral, Becky reminded him of a charity event for Wolfgang von Strucker Elementary and her desire to hire a nanny. Hank would agree to hiring a nanny after he found that his children's lunches had allergic food in them, he brought his kids to the wrong birthday party, and his baby drank Red Bull at said party. To deal with the charity event, he invited his friend, Clay Quartermain. However, this caused him to decline fellow Hydra agent, Coop's, offer to go to a Nests game. To pay for the nanny, Hank applied for a raise, obtaining the position of personal assistance of Madame Hydra, who would have Hank bend down in front of her. Later that day, Clay would tell Hank that he had to cancel. After asking Coop if he could still go, Coop revealed that the tickets were going to Clay, aggravating Hank. Hank and Becky would attend the unveiling of The Kiss of Hydra. While at the party, Madame Hydra would claim that that he never mentioned Becky and she squeezed his butt in front of her. After seeing that, Becky agreed to fire the nanny and have Hank be demoted, if he report Madame Hydra to Human Resources. The two would leave the party early and Clay would attempt to arrest them in the name of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Angry over the tickets, Hank attacked Clay, disarming him. The next day, Hank reported Madame Hydra to Human Resources. He invited M.O.D.O.K., who unbeknownst to Hank, was Madame Hydra's husband. Hydra Tower would once again be invaded Nick Fury, who once again knocked out Hank. This time, Coop would die in front of Hank.

Hank would agree to hiring a nanny after he found that his children's lunches had allergic food in them, he brought his kids to the wrong birthday party, and his baby drank Red Bull at said party. To deal with the charity event, he invited his friend, Clay Quartermain. However, this caused him to decline fellow Hydra agent, Coop's, offer to go to a Nests game. To pay for the nanny, Hank applied for a raise, obtaining the position of personal assistance of Madame Hydra, who would have Hank bend down in front of her. Later that day, Clay would tell Hank that he had to cancel. After asking Coop if he could still go, Coop revealed that the tickets were going to Clay, aggravating Hank. Hank and Becky would attend the unveiling of The Kiss of Hydra. While at the party, Madame Hydra would claim that that he never mentioned Becky and she squeezed his butt in front of her. After seeing that, Becky agreed to fire the nanny and have Hank be demoted, if he report Madame Hydra to Human Resources. The two would leave the party early and Clay would attempt to arrest them in the name of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Angry over the tickets, Hank attacked Clay, disarming him. The next day, Hank reported Madame Hydra to Human Resources. He invited M.O.D.O.K., who unbeknownst to Hank, was Madame Hydra's husband. Hydra Tower would once again be invaded Nick Fury, who once again knocked out Hank. This time, Coop would die in front of Hank.

hank jordan.name: Hank Jordan
hank jordan.origin: In 2095, Hank Jordan and his partner Tom Jonson were overseeing robots they were using to create an underground city called Project X-36. Halfway through construction, the robots all broke down. Tom cursed the robots, saying he hated all robots and wanted to destroy them. The partners were convinced their firm was going to become broke because of the failure, when suddenly atomic oil began to rain from the sky. The source of the oil rain was a strange electrically-charged planet passing above Earth. Tom decided to take a ship up to the planet to investigate while Hank stayed on Earth.

hank jurgens.name: Hank Jurgens
hank jurgens.origin: Concerned by televised violent and sexual content, Hank Jurgens and his wife joined Citizens Boycott for Morality. Hank hired Matt Murdock when he was set up by Sam Jutter for embezzlement. He invited Murdock at home for dinner and then showed him his licensed .38 caliber revolver. Frustrated by the lack of progress Matt was making, Jurgens decided to take the law into his own hands and confronted his accuser in Central Park, threatening him. DD turned up just in time to disarm Hank and gave him something of a beating, unaware that the previously enamoured Chuckie was watching him.

hank kelly.name: Hank Kelly
hank kelly.origin: ===Origins=== Hank "Combat" Kelly was a soldier in the United States Army who served in both World War II and the Korean War. Kelly was a womanizer and a glutton who loved combat and often placed himself in seemingly impossible situations and surviving unscathed. When he wasn't in combat situations he was eating or trying to charm any woman that passed him by. Not much is known about his past, and there is conflicting information based on his claims. He has stated father was a soldier in World War I who often told him stories about the war . However in another account, Combat claimed that he didn't know who his parents were due to the fact that he was an orphan . ===World War II=== When the United States entered World War II, Kelly was deployed to Europe where his fearlessness earned him the nickname "Combat Kelly" while battling Nazi forces. It was during the War he met his long time friend Cookie Novak. During his tours of Europe, Combat was regularly under the command of Captain Thorn and Sargent O'Hoolian. He often fought under Captain Thorn's Baker Company. On March 1, 1943, Combat and Cookie were were among a unit that clashed with Erwin Rommel's Afrika Corps, beating them to a strategic watering hole . April 7th that same year the pair were part of the America II Corps that were stationed in Africa, where they clashed again with the Nazi's Afrika Corps and Erwin Rommel. They located a secret bunker where Rommel and his troops hid their tanks between attacks and marked it for American bombers . On January 22, 1944, Combat and Cookie were shipped to Anzio, Italy, where they fought alongside the 5th Armored Division as part of Operation: Shingle. There they foiled a plot by the Nazis to use miniaturized tanks filled with explosives . On February 1st 1944, Combat and Cookie were part of the 5th Army Division and assisted in clearing out Nazi forces that had holed up in St. Benedict's Cathedral in Italy . During the spring, Combat and Cookie were under the command of Captain Thorn in the 34th Infantry Division (the Sandstorm Division), battling Nazi forces in Italy, and wrecking an enemy supply line headed for Rome . Later in their first recorded mission with Baker Company, Combat and Cookie managed to incapacitate an entire army of Nazis with wine found in a wine cellar in a small Italian village . On June 6, 1944, Combat and Cookie were part of the 29th Blue Grey Division, seeing action 17 miles off the coast of Omaha with Nazi forces. They were captured but freed by the French "rat run" that helped freed captured Allied soldiers . On June 11th 1944, Combat and Cookie crossed paths with a Nazi supply truck shipping the Nazis new V-1 rockets, destroying a large supply of them. Finding the launching site, the pair then sabotaged the rockets. The next day when the Nazis attempted to launch the rockets at London, most ended up striking Berlin instead, with only one hitting London. Embarrassed by this defeated, Adolf Hitler ordered a cover up of the failure .In August of that year, Combat and Cookie were instrumental in helping Allied Forces break past the Nazi's Siegfried Line through France . Late that month, the pair were part of the 90th Infantry Division (The Alamo Infantry) where they destroyed Nazi tanks poised to attack American positions . In July of that year, Combat and Cookie were in Livorno (Leghorn) Italy destroying Nazi jets. During this operation they had the incredible luck of capturing Adolf Hitler while fleeing enemy forces. They then forced Hitler to bring them to various air bases and order the troops there to destroy them. With their mission completed this way, they then shaved off Hitler's mustache and dressed him up in a GI uniform and turned him over to Nazi authorities as an "American soldier" and escaped while Hitler was left to prove who he really was . Relocating to Sicily, Combat and Cookie made a bet with British and Canadian soldiers that they could liberate the town of Messina before they could. Sure enough on July 10, 1944 the pair managed to overcome great odds to get to the town first and clear it of Nazi forces before their fellow Allies . On July 17, 1944, Combat and Cookie were stationed in the Pacific Theatre where they assisted in the liberation of Onna Atoll and later Kawawa Atoll from Imperial Japanese forces . By November 8, 1944, Combat and Cookie were stationed in Africa where they foiled Nazi tank attacks during Operation Torch . In December 1944, Combat and Cookie clashed with Nazi ski patrols in the mountains of Italy . Shortly thereafter they were redeployed to Bastogne, Beligum where they used Jerry cans of gasoline to destroy Nazi tanks. After this battle Combat was awarded the Silver Star from General S. Patton himself . In February of 1945, Combat and Cookie returned to Europe where they were part of the 29th Blue Grey Division clashing with Nazi forces along the Rhine River where they uncovered that the twin brother of Sargent Bonner had kidnapped and to

hank prim.origin: As the Giant-Man and an early member of the Revengers, he found very funny when Doctor Doof's metal armor was magnetized by Mangeeto. The Revengers also supported the Fantastical Four when they became musicians (and send them tickets for their concerts). He became a supervillain then had a breakdown, then divorced, then went to prison, then became a hero again. He also shrank himself, visited Ben Grimm's shoulder, and was nearly crushed by the Thang's dandruff. He eventually established himself as an entrepreneur, owning a super market with coupons offering superhero-related junk.

hank pym.name: Hank Pym
hank pym.species: Human mutate by the Pym Particles. Continued exposure altered his body, allowing it to naturally produce them. Briefly turned into a cyborg.
hank pym.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|left|119px|Pym as a child Henry Jonathan Pym was born the son of Brad and Doris Pym in East Nowhere, Nebraska. While his father was a factory foreman and his mother was a bookkeeper, their son proved to be highly intelligent. Tested by doctors at the age of 3, Pym was determined to be smarter than both of his parents combined intelligence. An inquisitive young boy, Henry often tried to emulate things that he saw on television, such as a time when he stained his skin blue to look like an alien in a movie. While his parents were upset, Henry was always encouraged to pursue his curiosity by his grandmother, Angela, who was a science fiction author. Henry's scientific ingenuity and childish curiosity was influenced by his grandmother's tales of science fiction, further exasperating Henry's parents when Henry began making his own inventions at a young age. By the age of 5, Henry built a typewriter that could type in 14 different colors. Later, when he created a device that could make the horn in his father's car make any sound he could, Brad Pym asked his son if he could build a carburetor. Angela told her son that anyone could build one of those and continued to encourage Henry to use his imagination to the fullest when building. When Henry was 7 years old, his grandmother fell terminally ill. Saddened by this, young Henry attempted to build a device that could cure her. While flattered by the effort, Angela Pym had accepted that it was her time to die and told her grandson to never stop reaching for the clouds. When Angela died moments later, Henry angrily smashed his device. After the funeral, Henry decided to follow his father's advice and built his own carburetor the very next day. Pym went on creating a string of inventions, each one more dull than the last, over the next 15 years. His academic career was strictly followed by his professors and school administrators who constantly discouraged Pym's use of his own imagination and inventing things for fun by being told that he would never invent anything that would impact the world. One of them suggested to Pym that he "should stick to practical projects". Pym responded that he only wanted to work on projects that appealed to his own imagination. Pym excelled better than any of his fellow classmates, earning his doctorate while his friends were still undergrads. ===First Marriage=== thumb|Pym and his first wife, Maria Trovaya During his final years in university, Pym was dragged along by his colleagues to a party where he met Maria Trovaya, a Hungarian immigrant living in the United States. The two fell quickly in love and were soon married. On their honeymoon, Maria convinced Henry to take her back to her home country. There, Pym expressed his desire to spend all his time with her. Joking about the prospect of having a "lazy husband", Maria offered her new husband a motto from her father, "Go to the ants, thou dullard!". During this time, Pym was working on a formula to shrink objects but was having difficulty finding funding. Not long into their honeymoon, old political enemies of Maria's father recognized her and shot her in the head right in front of Henry. Pym recovered from his injuries in a United States Embassy in Hungary. However, when he felt like the Embassy was not doing enough to catch the men who murdered his wife, Pym decided to go and hunt for them himself. Eventually, he had his first of many mental breakdowns and went on a rampage, getting himself arrested and jailed by the Hungarian authorities. The U.S. Embassy managed to negotiate his release and, unable to find who was responsible for killing his wife, Henry was forced to return to the United States. ===Discovering Pym Particles=== Pym became the world's hardest working biochemist, but the lack of innovation in his experiments eventually became too much for him. While working on a development program paid for by the Roxxon Oil Company, Pym was distracted by an ant farm, and when his employer got on his case, Pym finally lost his temper. Ranting about not being able to use his imagination, Pym angrily hurled the ant farm across the room and quit his job. Henry later began working with a scientist named Albert Poole in developing a robot named Grutan. When Pym accidentally damaged an audio impulse generator, he was scolded and left. Since then Pym always worked alone. thumb|Pym shrinking for the first time Henry was haunted with nightmares of the murder of his wife, but one day became inspired by her father's motto and decided to use his scientific prowess to try and fight crime while continuing to create his size-changing formula. Inspired by ants, he began to study entomology and experimenting to find a means to shrink objects down to "ant size" as well as restore them to normal. fields.history: ===Early Life=== thumb|left|119px|Pym as a child Henry Jonathan Pym was born the son of Brad and Doris Pym in East Nowhere, Nebraska. While his father was a factory foreman and his mother was a bookkeeper, their son proved to be highly intelligent. Tested by doctors at the age of 3, Pym was determined to be smarter than both of his parents combined intelligence. An inquisitive young boy, Henry often tried to emulate things that he saw on television, such as a time when he stained his skin blue to look like an alien in a movie. While his parents were upset, Henry was always encouraged to pursue his curiosity by his grandmother, Angela, who was a science fiction author. Henry's scientific ingenuity and childish curiosity was influenced by his grandmother's tales of science fiction, further exasperating Henry's parents when Henry began making his own inventions at a young age. By the age of 5, Henry built a typewriter that could type in 14 different colors. Later, when he created a device that could make the horn in his father's car make any sound he could, Brad Pym asked his son if he could build a carburetor. Angela told her son that anyone could build one of those and continued to encourage Henry to use his imagination to the fullest when building. When Henry was 7 years old, his grandmother fell terminally ill. Saddened by this, young Henry attempted to build a device that could cure her. While flattered by the effort, Angela Pym had accepted that it was her time to die and told her grandson to never stop reaching for the clouds. When Angela died moments later, Henry angrily smashed his device. After the funeral, Henry decided to follow his father's advice and built his own carburetor the very next day. Pym went on creating a string of inventions, each one more dull than the last, over the next 15 years. His academic career was strictly followed by his professors and school administrators who constantly discouraged Pym's use of his own imagination and inventing things for fun by being told that he would never invent anything that would impact the world. One of them suggested to Pym that he "should stick to practical projects". Pym responded that he only wanted to work on projects that appealed to his own imagination. Pym excelled better than any of his fellow classmates, earning his doctorate while his friends were still undergrads. ===First Marriage=== thumb|Pym and his first wife, Maria Trovaya During his final years in university, Pym was dragged along by his colleagues to a party where he met Maria Trovaya, a Hungarian immigrant living in the United States. The two fell quickly in love and were soon married. On their honeymoon, Maria convinced Henry to take her back to her home country. There, Pym expressed his desire to spend all his time with her. Joking about the prospect of having a "lazy husband", Maria offered her new husband a motto from her father, "Go to the ants, thou dullard!". During this time, Pym was working on a formula to shrink objects but was having difficulty finding funding. Not long into their honeymoon, old political enemies of Maria's father recognized her and shot her in the head right in front of Henry. Pym recovered from his injuries in a United States Embassy in Hungary. However, when he felt like the Embassy was not doing enough to catch the men who murdered his wife, Pym decided to go and hunt for them himself. Eventually, he had his first of many mental breakdowns and went on a rampage, getting himself arrested and jailed by the Hungarian authorities. fields.personality: Early in his career, Pym worried about what would happen if he someday met defeat and death. He wanted someone to carry on his crime-fighting campaign if he died. In order to avoid contemplating his past, Pym worked obsessively at his laboratory. He took little nourishment or sleep while working. This suggests that his health problems could be partly caused by malnutrition and sleep deprivation. Pym explicitly stated in that he is an atheist. As Ant-Man, Pym had a deep emotional connection to some of his ants. When Korr, a winged ant, sacrificed its life to save Pym, he was deeply disturbed by its death.
fields.additional_attributes: Mental Problems: Pym has suffered a series of mental breakdowns over the years. At one point, Pym created a separate personality for himself as "Yellowjacket", but claimed to have actually killed Pym. He was eventually identified as suffering from bipolar disorder.
fields.notes: An altenate account of the Wasp's origin is given in . When Vernon was murdered, Janet went to Pym directly and revealed that she had figured out that he was secretly Ant-Man. She convinced Henry to help her find her father's killer; finding Janet so much like Maria, Pym agreed to conduct his experiments that endowed her with her Wasp powers. Ant-Man examined Vernon's body, finding traces of formic acid on the body. He then developed a single antidote and they went to confront the Creature from Kosmos. The Wasp took the antidote from Ant-Man and flew up and dumped the chemical compound on Kosmos, destroying the creature. During the process of doing so, the Wasp professed her love to Pym. When they got back to Pym's apartment, he scolded her for so foolishly risking her life. On March 29, 2011, many years after Pym's marriage to Van Dyne ended, writer Jim Shooter publicly commented on the infamous story arc via a blog in which he denounced the claims that Pym was a "wife-beater". He explained that he had intended for Pym to strike Van Dyne accidentally, but when artist Bob Hall drew the panel, the exaggerated motion made it appear as if he deliberately slapped her. Shooter claimed that there was not enough time before his deadline to have the frames redrawn, and as a result, the details of Pym's personal suffering were overshadowed by his being labelled a "wife-beater". Hall subsequently commented that he was still new to the industry at the time he drew the panel, and admitted that the final product may have been in stark contrast to Shooter's intent. He also acknowledged that Shooter most likely would have had the panel redrawn had there been time. In a French animated series called Les Ratz, Pym has been mentioned as Grand-Man.
fields.trivia: Pym is the one who wrote the famous Avengers' Oath into the team's charters. Pym is recognized as a Caltech fellow in the school of extra-dimensional studies. Pym's first costume as Goliath (the yellow and blue one) was designed by the Scarlet Witch. Pym is a Taurus.

hanna levy.name: Hanna Levy
hanna levy.origin: Hanna Levy was a resident of Mutant Town, living in McCarthy Avenue, and the neighbor and friend of Mister M. She has a degree in social history and works for the North American Historical Review, a highly regarded journal. Her mutation was a prehensile tongue which helped her catch insects, the only thing she could digest. Her friendship with Mr. M was strained after he told her his plans for Mutant Town: after seeing a premonitional painting of himself as a destroyer, he decided that the only way he could make a difference in Mutant Town was to obliterate all the sickness and corruption. He attempted to destroy the town but failed, distancing himself from Hanna. thumb|left|175px|"Assaulted" by bugs ===M-Day=== After M-Day, Mutant Town was in chaos. Bishop and Ortega tried to estimate the damage. Along with Charlotte Jones, Bishop was sent to her flat as there was a report of gunshots. There, they found Hannah being attacked by a swarm of bugs. She used to eat bugs as a part of her mutant power, and she believed that they were coming back for revenge. This caused her to become mentally unstable. They brought her to the Bellevue Hospital, where she was visited by Mr. M who used his powers to restore her mental state. She then suggested that he go to the Xavier Institute, which he agreed to.

Jim Braddock and his team opened the coffin to reveal the coffin of Starr the Slayer with a Star Brand on his forehead. Hannah and Leonard discussed the discovery of the skeleton. Leonard was convinced that they have unearthed Zardath, The First City, but Hannah is skeptical. Jim comes in with an arc lamp and Hannah says that her father has something similar. Len is now convinced that they have found the city as it was described as The Shining City. Jim then informs him that they got a Geiger counter reading off the bottom of the trench which stuns Len.

hannah chung.name: Hannah Chung
hannah chung.origin: Hannah Chung was the daughter of illegal Chinese immigrant Lu Wei. Because she was born on American soil, Hannah was a legal citizen, unlike her older brother Sam. Hannah lived with Sam, and he supported both of them on his own. After Lu Wei took Sam back to China, Hannah was left on her own. She found herself forced to work as a barista for fifteen hours a day to stay alive. Residents of Chinatown continued to leave red envelopes to Blindspot (Sam) even after he was gone, and Daredevil began handling some of the claims. He visited Hannah, telling the truth about her brother's secret identity as Blindspot and working as a hero vigilante. He asked Hannah to help read the text. She reluctantly helped to translate and read the notes to Daredevil so he could try to help them. As she read through the cards, she found a card addressed to Daredevil. One night, Hannah was shocked to find Sam at the hideout after he'd been missing and out of communication for months. While Sam prepared his plans to capture Muse, he explained to her that their mom intervened to get his eyes back and was still in China. He then said his goodbyes to Hannah as if they would never see each other again, causing her to worry.
